text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — smart-routing imbalance detected (priority lanes)
oncall-bot: Severity: P1 | Affected: hosted inference | Symptom: upward token tail in gold/silver lanes causing backlog
oncall-bot: Paging: @iris (primary on-call), @samir (backup). Please acknowledge.
iris: ack — seeing errors in the metrics dashboard, gold lane latency spike ~2.1s and queue depth rising
samir: +1, also seeing an increase in 429s for free-tier customers in us-west
marie: FYI customer support reporting escalations from two mid-market customers complaining about timeouts
iris: quick triage — suspect routing policy churn after the last config rollout. I'll pull the policy audit
ops-bot: Audit log snippet: `2026-03-15T08:42:01Z update_route_policy id=rp-78 changed_by=deploy-bot diff="priority_weights: gold:0.5->0.65"`
iris: yep that matches. new weights pushed 10m ago. Gold got more traffic than expected. Starting live mitigation: throttle gold priority lane by reducing weight and enable temporary rate caps on free tokens
dylan: suggested mitigation: set gold weight -20% and enable per-customer soft quota of 5rps for free tier. Are we ok with that customer impact? Support impact window estimate?
marie: support: free-tier will see degraded throughput, paid platinum unaffected. We have ~8 affected free customers, 2 escalations in queue
samir: I'll run the policy change. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing update rp-78 --set weight.gold=0.52 --set weight.silver=0.30 --enable soft_quota.free=5rps --reason "mitigate gold queue spike"
```
samir: deploying now
oncall-bot: ACTION LOGGED by samir at 1908765452
ops-bot: Can we reroute eu-west gold->eu-west-low-latency pool for short window instead of global weight change?
iris: good call. Let's do region-scoped steer for eu-west to absorb local burst. samir, apply region override for eu-west to favor low-latency pool for gold only
samir: applying region override:
```
redwoodctl routing update rp-78 --region eu-west --set weight.gold_pool=low-latency --reason "local burst absorb"
```
samir: override applied at 1908765468
oncall-bot: MONITORING: gold lane queue depth decreasing in eu-west; global gold queue still high but trending down
iris: monitoring token-level latency and KV cache hit — cache hit improved in eu-west after steer. Good sign
dylan: cost note: moving gold to low-latency pool increases per-token cost for eva customers by ~12% while override active
iris: acknowledged. We'll keep override until queue stabilizes under target (queue_depth < 50 and p95 latency < 800ms)
marie: support: telling affected customers that we're doing targeted traffic shaping to stabilize latency, eta ~15-30m
samir: after 5m observe, global gold weight adjusted again to 0.50 to reduce cross-region bleed. Command: `weight.gold=0.50`
oncall-bot: ACTION LOGGED by samir at 1908765485
iris: p95 latency now ~720ms global; eu-west p95 ~380ms, queue depth global 42
dylan: recommend keeping soft_quota.free=5rps for another 10m then relax to 10rps if stable
marie: support: noted, will update customer threads in 10m
iris: handoff: @samir — I'll go offline for a quick meeting at 1908765499, you're primary for next 30m. Leave any further mitigation notes here. If we need rollback, escalate to platform lead @dylan
samir: ack handoff. I'll continue to monitor and will post updates. Removing non-critical feature flags in gold path is on standby if we see recurrence
ops-bot: PLAYBOOK REMINDER: if repeating spikes within 30m, escalate to tiered-routing rollback and open canary to reduce gold weight to 0.35
oncall-bot: THREAD CLOSED (temporary mitigation stable) at 1908765499 — reopen if metrics regress
